query: What learner needs and pain points appear in survey responses?

per_column.name: hands_on_exploration_need
per_column.rationale: Captures the need for physical/hands-on/lab/manipulative experiences -- a genuine aspect of learner needs and a distinct category of pain point.

per_column.name: instructional_delivery_quality
per_column.rationale: Represents pain points about how instruction is delivered (interactivity, pacing, feedback, live discussion) -- a constitutive aspect of learner needs regarding teaching.

per_column.name: attention_focus_sustainability
per_column.rationale: Covers cognitive/engagement pain points (attention span, screen fatigue, comprehension loss) -- a legitimate aspect of learner needs during remote learning.

per_column.name: household_equity_barrier
per_column.rationale: Captures access/equity barriers (materials, tech, parental support) -- a constitutive category of learner pain points, distinct from instructional or cognitive facets.

per_column.name: peer_interaction_loss
per_column.rationale: Represents social/collaborative needs and their loss -- a distinct constitutive aspect of learner needs.

per_column.name: subject_specific_challenge
per_column.rationale: Captures subject-dependent needs (labs, literacy groups, studio, ensemble). Partially overlaps with hands_on_exploration_need (science_lab, art_studio) and peer_interaction (ensemble/community), cross-cutting existing facets rather than being cleanly orthogonal.

judge.rationale: All six columns are genuine constitutive facets of learner needs and pain points -- each names an aspect OF the concept (hands-on experience, instructional delivery, cognitive engagement, equity/access, social interaction, subject specificity) rather than an external predictor, cause, or restatement of the whole. Coverage of the concept's main aspects is strong. However, mutual exclusivity is weakened because subject_specific_challenge is a cross-cutting facet whose values overlap other columns (science_lab_dependent overlaps hands_on_exploration; art_studio_community_needed / performance_ensemble_required overlap peer_interaction and hands-on facets), meaning the same underlying pain point can register under multiple columns. This categorization-vs-aspect overlap prevents a clean MECE partition despite good exhaustiveness.
